selection: First newest first-parent source change in latest 100 source-directory commits per root (message contains fix, handle or catch) with modified package Python source and changed test module. Expanded from fix-only before any test outcomes: ItsDangerous uses handle/catch for exception corrections. No replacement after results.
design: Frozen before outcomes; upstream tests changed in the chosen commit; fixed tests paired with parent package sources. No outcome-based exclusions or replacements.
reference_rule: Fixed exit 0; parent exit 1 without collection errors. Skipped/unreproduced cases retained.
comparison: Full declared changed-test pool versus selector intersection with that pool; no whole-repository savings claim.
